claims.text: Estrogen ⍉shrinks a cystocele; vaginal estrogen can still treat coexisting vaginal atrophy
claims.quote: There is no evidence that estrogen's topical or systemic use reduces the size of cystocele; the creams or estrogen-containing vaginal pessaries can still be used for women with cystocele for treating signs of vaginal atrophy, which may occur concurrently.
